method: Actual approved native actor walk frames1..9 with authored root.scale1.25, no fit or pose edits; actual visible cocoa-shoe triangle lower envelope sampled every.0025 world versus independently evaluated native stair/deck BVHs and ground0. Upward shoe ray finds lowest sole at eachXY; downward environment ray finds actual support top. Full actual body triangles are clipped to native post/cap YZslabs for conservative lateral clearance. All4facings transformed back to same physical floor space.
